NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To suggest your latest video in Spotter, as you asked. {nom} only reads the most recent one and never changes your gallery; only a few frames leave your iPhone, when you tap “Search”.
NSCameraUsageDescription: To take a photo of a piece you want to find in Spotter, or your profile photo. The photo isn't saved to your gallery; it only leaves your iPhone when you tap “Search” or “Confirm”.
